verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail's own developers page says users can 'use our API directly to take full control of your workflow', so a first-party public API is claimed. The pack has no endpoint reference, auth details or examples, and probes for an OpenAPI spec, llms.txt and markdown docs all returned 404. Those 404s show a thin documentation surface, not that the API fails to work. Missing for 10: actual API reference documentation (endpoints, auth, operations covered), a machine-readable spec, and independent or hands-on confirmation the API works.
